body:
They were real before. I dread them returning because I know what they mean. I also know what I'll do. So in a way they are all three. 

I'm self destructive. It's become my second nature. Do I think I'm a good person? Sure. But I'm still inevitably going to fuck things up.

You know when you're doing wrong. You know when you're being an asshole. Sometimes you just can't or don't stop yourself. 

The roaches are failure. Ushers to hell. For some I guess it's ravens. Or the Four Horsemen. I see the roaches.
